name: Charge-exchange reaction-kernel verification
purpose: Verify each enabled charge-exchange channel, rate, products, momentum handling, and budgets.
production_capability: Moon charge-exchange reaction table and production chemistry dispatch.
configuration: One deterministic fixture per documented reaction channel.
independent_reference: Published channel formula/table and particle/species conservation identities.
units: m^2 or m^3 s^-1, kg m s^-1, J
frame_time_convention: Declared model frame; event-local time only.
deterministic_stochastic_controls: Fixed seeds and >=100000 events for probabilistic branches.
procedure: Check rates, products, branch frequencies, charge/species budgets, and velocity/momentum convention.
acceptance_criteria: Must be frozen per authoritative channel before activation; no undocumented channel is accepted.
expected_pass_result: Every enabled channel is traceable and budget-consistent.
required_data: authoritative channel data not yet assigned a Dxx package
status_semantics: SKIPPED; missing authoritative channel specification is not PASS.
skip_reason: No Moon charge-exchange channels or authoritative channel table are configured.
missing_capability: Documented production reaction table and mapping.
